entities.title: Au-Pair in Germany
entities.summary: Information for au-pair applications at the German Consulate-General Karachi.
eligibility: Valid au-pair contract with a hosting family in Germany
Hosting family is not of Pakistani origin and consists of at least one child under 18 years old
Applicant is between 18 and 27 years old
Applicant has never done an au-pair in Germany before
Applicant has German language proficiency level A1 CEFR
required_documents: Proof of German language proficiency level A1 CEFR
application_process: Prepare visa application as explained in the checklist
Submit application through the Consular Services Portal
important_notes: Applications at the German Embassy Islamabad are handled via the Consular Services Portal
Applicant must have a valid au-pair contract with a hosting family in Germany
mandatory_prerequisites: German language proficiency level A1 CEFR
